Class finish_order_window

java.lang.Object
controller.finish_order_window
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class finish_order_window extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controls the final step of placing an employee order.

Handles phone-number validation, payment-type selection, final order confirmation, and saving completed order information to the order history table. After an order is successfully processed, the active order is cleared and a confirmation window is displayed.

Order totals, tax, tip, employee username, drink information, and customer payment information are collected from the employee ordering controller before the database records are created.

Version:
1.0
Author:

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL location, ResourceBundle resources)
      Initializes the finish-order window when the FXML view is loaded.

      A listener is added to the phone-number field so only numeric characters remain in the field. Once a value is entered, the red validation border is removed and the normal field appearance is restored.

    • handlePayTypeSelection

      private void handlePayTypeSelection(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Stores and displays the payment type selected for the current order.

      Parameters:

    • handlePlaceOrderButtonClick

      private void handlePlaceOrderButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Validates the final order information and completes the order.

      The phone number must contain exactly ten digits and a payment type must be selected. Invalid phone input receives a red border, while a missing payment type briefly highlights the payment menu button.

      When validation succeeds, the phone number is formatted, the order is saved to the database, the finish-order window is closed, and the active order is cleared. A confirmation popup is then displayed.

      Parameters:
      event - action event triggered by the Place Order button

    • saveOrderToDatabase

      private void saveOrderToDatabase()
      Saves the completed order and its items to the order history table.

      A new order ID is calculated from the largest existing order ID. The method then collects the current timestamp, subtotal, tax, tip, total, and active employee username from the main ordering controller.

      Each drink in the active order is inserted as a separate database row using the same order ID. Tip, tax, and combined total are stored only on the first item row, while later item rows store null values for those fields. All item rows are added to a batch before the database insert is executed.
